products.about: Cumin , Jeera is a flowering plant in the family Apiaceae, native to the Irano-Turanian Region. Its seeds – each one contained within a fruit, which is dried – are used in the cuisines of many cultures in both whole and ground form

products.name: Fenugreek Seeds

Its seeds and leaves are common ingredients in dishes from the Indian subcontinent, and have been used as a culinary ingredient since ancient times

products.name: Coconut Oil
products.about: Coconut oil is made by pressing fresh coconut meat or dried coconut meat called copra. Coconut oil is a white solid fat below around 25 °C (77 °F), and a clear thin liquid oil in warmer climates.

products.name: Extra Virgin Coconut Oil
products.about: Virgin coconut oil uses fresh meat, while refined coconut oil typically uses copra. Unlike olive oil, the terms “virgin” and “extra virgin” are not regulated with coconut oil.

products.name: Groundnut Oil
products.about: Peanut oil, also known as groundnut oil or arachis oil, is a vegetable oil derived from peanuts. The oil usually has a mild or neutral flavor but, if made with roasted peanuts, has a stronger peanut flavor and aroma.

products.name: Mustard Oil
products.about: Mustard oil is reddish-brown or amber in colour and is known for its strong smell and pungent sharp flavour. The pungency of mustard oil is due to the presence of allyl isothiocyanate. This fatty vegetable oil is obtained by pressing mustard seeds

products.name: Sesame Oil
products.about: Sesame oil is an edible vegetable oil derived from sesame seeds. Sesame Seed Oil widely known as Til Oil in India is extracted from the best-selected sesame seeds.

products.name: Olive Oil
products.about: Olive oil is a liquid fat obtained by pressing whole olives, the fruit of Olea europaea, a traditional tree crop of the Mediterranean Basin, and extracting the oil. Olive oil varies in colour from clear yellow to golden; some varieties obtained from unripe fruit have a greenish tinge.

products.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
products.about: Extra virgin olive oil is highest quality, most flavorful and most expensive type of olive oil because it's unrefined--never heated or processed with chemicals. Extra virgin olive oil is the least processed form of olive oil. Due to this, it retains its natural antioxidants and vitamins.

products.name: Pure Ghee
products.about: Ghee is a semi-solid at room temperature, but it can be easily melted or liquified when heated. Ghee has a nutty, buttery flavor and a high smoke point, making it ideal for frying and sautéing. Ghee is often made from cow's milk, but it can also be made from the milk of goats, sheep, or buffalo.

products.name: A2 Ghee
products.about: A2 ghee means a type of clarified butter that is made from the milk of cows that naturally produce the A2 beta-casein protein. A2 cow ghee is grainy in texture and is made by heating butter on low flame for a long duration.
